title: Working Paper of the Equity Accounting Desk: What a Year's Revolvement Pays on a Membership and Patronage Equity Account
content:
The equity revolved on a membership under Membership and Patronage Equity is drawn from the whole of the equity standing unrevolved on its equity ledger, which is the equity portions credited on its allocation notices plus its capital retains less everything already revolved out, rounded to two decimal places.

The share revolved is the percentage of that equity the class's annual pool fixes. The payment carries no weighting for the member's standing. The class's own dividend rate on preferred equity is applied to the same equity, and nothing is taken off for what the member owes the cooperative.

The pool share is worked out first and rounded to two decimal places, the weighting for standing then acts on that rounded figure and the result is rounded to two decimal places, the dividend is worked out on the same equity and rounded to two decimal places, the two are added, what is owed is taken off the sum and the remainder floored at nothing.

The payment is then held back so that it is no more than the share the class's annual pool fixes of the credits the fiscal year drawn on carries, and the result is rounded to two decimal places. Amounts under this rule are carried to two decimal places, and a half cent rounds up.

## The working paper, on hypothetical figures

| Line | Quantity | Figure |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | equity portions credited on the allocation notices | 7200.00 |
| 2 | capital retains credited | 980.00 |
| 3 | everything already revolved out | 1180.00 |
| 4 | equity standing unrevolved, lines 1 and 2 added and line 3 taken off, rounded | 7000.00 |
| 5 | pool share at a class annual pool of 8 in the hundred, worked on line 4 and rounded | 560.00 |
| 6 | line 5 after the weighting for standing, rounded | 560.00 |
| 7 | dividend on line 4 at a class dividend rate of 0 in the hundred, rounded | 0.00 |
| 8 | lines 6 and 7 added | 560.00 |
| 9 | what is owed, taken off line 8, the remainder floored at nothing | 560.00 |
| 10 | the hold-back: the class's annual pool share of the credits the fiscal year drawn on carries | 560.00 |
| 11 | the payment, being the lower of lines 9 and 10, rounded to two decimal places | 560.00 |

The order of the lines matters: the pool share is rounded before the weighting acts on it, and the dividend is worked out on the equity of line 4 rather than on the pool share.
